posts.title: Cross compiling CGO with Dagger and Zig
posts.description: Anyone who's built a substantial Go project that incorporates C code (like sqlite ) knows that cross compiling with CGO can be very painful. One of Go's best native features is that you can use your system's cross compiler (like XCode's bundled gcc) to easily build binaries for whatever system is supported by go tool dist list (like linux/amd64 or darwin/arm64 ).
